content: LLM packaging best practices for k8s incident context: set token budgets; redact before paste; prefer events+describe over raw full logs; head+tail log truncation with explicit omitted-line markers; scope to namespace/failing resources; system prompt that asks for ranked hypotheses and next checks; avoid dumping unbounded archives into chat. Pipelines-as-Code and production AI troubleshooting guides recommend low max_lines (tens–low hundreds) and selective context.
